thought.text: Let me test the v2 protocol and a pandoc-based DOCX extraction.

reasoning_content:
PDF extraction works via pdftotext. Now let me test the v2 protocol to verify the extended response, though it may require LLM. Let me test with a simple DOCX (pandoc) to exercise more. Actually let me test v2 on the text file - it will try docmeta LLM and fail gracefully. Let me try.

Also test a DOCX (pandoc built-in). Let me create one.

action.command:
cd /tmp && printf 'Hello v2 protocol\n' > v2.txt
echo "=== v2 plain text (LLM unreachable expected) ==="
curl -s -m 90 -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' -H 'X-Taki-Protocol: v2' -H 'X-Taki-Features: meta' -H 'X-Taki-Source-Ref: space1/file.txt' --data-binary @v2.txt http://localhost:9998/rmeta/text | head -c 700; echo
echo "=== log ==="; docker logs open_taki_test 2>&1 | tail -5
